summary: deepseek-harness publishes no headline agent-accuracy results: no SWE-bench, HumanEval or LiveCodeBench, and its README has no numbers. Its real quantitative evidence is engineering performance: CI-enforced latency/memory benchmarks (benchmarks/*.bench.ts, `pnpm run test:bench`) whose calibration samples and medians are committed in agent notes. These are reproducible as gates, though absolute numbers are machine-dependent. The only agent-quality numbers sit in one internal note (Pass@1 −0.03pp / Pass@3 +0.70pp for a prompt tweak across six benchmarks), and the eval harness and data behind them are not in the repo.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
